mapper.select: SELECT PR.code FROM r_auth_users_units_roles UR INNER JOIN t_permission_role PR ON PR.id = UR.role_id AND PR.role_type = 'app' INNER JOIN t_app A ON A.id = UR.unit_id AND A.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE UR.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND UR.unit_id = #{appId} AND UR.unit_type = 'app' AND UR.user_id = #{userId} AND (UR.expired_time IS NULL OR UR.expired_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND PR.code IN ('app_owner', 'app_admin', 'app_dev')

SELECT UR.id, UR.user_id AS user_id, U.username, PR.code AS role_code, UR.expired_time FROM r_auth_users_units_roles UR INNER JOIN t_permission_role PR ON PR.id = UR.role_id AND PR.role_type = 'app' LEFT JOIN t_user U ON U.id = UR.user_id AND U.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE UR.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND UR.unit_id = #{appId} AND UR.unit_type = 'app' AND PR.code IN ('app_owner', 'app_admin', 'app_dev') ORDER BY CASE PR.code WHEN 'app_owner' THEN 1 WHEN 'app_admin' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, UR.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO r_auth_users_units_roles (user_id, unit_id, unit_type, tenant_id, role_id, owner_guard, expired_time, created_by, created_time, last_updated_by, last_updated_time) SELECT #{userId}, #{appId}, 'app', #{tenantId}, PR.id, CASE WHEN PR.code = 'app_owner' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END, #{expiredTime}, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM t_permission_role PR WHERE PR.code = #{roleCode} AND PR.role_type = 'app'
mapper.update: UPDATE r_auth_users_units_roles SET role_id = (SELECT PR.id FROM t_permission_role PR WHERE PR.code = #{roleCode} AND PR.role_type = 'app'), owner_guard = NULL, expired_time = #{expiredTime}, last_updated_by = #{operator}, last_updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND unit_id = #{appId} AND unit_type = 'app' AND user_id = #{userId} AND role_id IN (SELECT PR.id FROM t_permission_role PR WHERE PR.role_type = 'app' AND PR.code IN ('app_admin', 'app_dev'))
